newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks dip further at close.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks dip further at close.

text.p: Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange ended lower on Thursday as sellers panicked by a continuing slide outnumbered hesitant buyers, brokers said.
The panic was boosted by speculations that the market would remain dull during Moslem fasting month of Ramadan starting Staurday.
The DSE all-share index shed 57.24 points or 2.65 percent at 2,100.96 on a turnover of 55.3 million taka on Thursday. Of the total 79 issues traded, 10 gained and 68 lost.
Singer Bangladesh Ltd lost 395 taka to 12,969, United Leasing Company lost 225.50 to 2,477 and Beximco Ltd lost 19.95 to 264.
